author: Kyle Stratis
message:
Add PENDING_APPROVAL recovery mechanism for stuck agents

When the bot crashes while a tool is awaiting client-side approval,
the Letta agent gets stuck in PENDING_APPROVAL state indefinitely.
This adds automatic recovery on startup:

- New _cancel_pending_approvals() method checks for and cancels
  pending tool approvals when finding an existing agent
- Processes ALL pending approvals (not just the first)
- Comprehensive error handling and RECOVERY: prefixed logging
- 9 new tests covering all edge cases

Also includes:
- Option A env file pattern (.env.local for dev, .env for prod)
- Letta mise tasks (letta:up, letta:down, letta:logs, etc.)
- Updated healthcheck to use /v1/models endpoint
- Syncthing deployment documentation

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: Kyle Stratis
message:
Integrate EidolonMemory with Letta for persistent memory

Add EidolonMemory system that wraps Letta SDK for per-user persistent memory:

- Add agents/eidolon/ module with client, memory blocks, and tool registry
- Add Docker configuration for Letta server with PostgreSQL
- Integrate EidolonMemory into bot client, replacing ConversationManager
- Update scheduler jobs to use EidolonMemory for AI operations
- Update slash commands in core.py to use eidolon.chat()
- Add ToolRegistry for native vault tool execution in bot process
- Remove unused claude_api_key from config (Letta handles LLM)
- Clean up stale ConversationManager exports from agents/__init__.py
- Update README with local development and DigitalOcean deployment
- Add docs/eidolon-memory.md with architecture documentation
- Add comprehensive tests for EidolonMemory module

This completes Phases 1-4 and 6 of the EidolonMemory implementation plan.

author: Kyle Stratis
message:
Add scheduler framework for automated jobs

- Create bot/scheduler/ module with ScheduledJob abstraction
- Implement APScheduler-based Scheduler class with cron scheduling
- Add 3 scheduled jobs:
  - DailyNoteJob: 6am daily note generation + morning briefing DM
  - EndOfDaySyncJob: 11:55pm bidirectional sync + rollover + summary DM
  - WeeklyReviewJob: Sunday 6pm review reminder DM
- Add scheduler configuration to Settings (timezone, cron expressions, toggles)
- Integrate scheduler with ErebusBot lifecycle (start/stop)
- Add cron expression validation at config load time
- Fix exception handling to catch specific JobLookupError
- Remove unused python-crontab dependency, pin apscheduler <4.0.0
- Comprehensive test coverage (36 new tests, 108 total passing)
